messages.label: code free
messages.note: Otherwise refused: 422 DUPLICATE_GROUP_CODE, before the handler runs

messages.label: insert AccountGroup + outbox row, one save
messages.note: new AccountGroup(code, name, description, type, ownerId, metadata), Status = Active. SlimBus EF Core interceptor auto-saves after the handler returns.

messages.label: account-groups.created event
messages.note: Dropped, not stored, if the bus is off. Retried indefinitely from the outbox if the bus is on but unreachable.

cards.title: One save, one event
items: The entity and its outbox row are written in the same database save
The event is raised by the save hook, never sent from application code

cards.title: What this can't show
items: The transaction boundary is the one SaveChanges call: entity and outbox row commit together or not at all
A group holds accounts only by reference (GroupId) — never a mapped EF Core relationship
